name: Empty Tray
summary: A bakery 404 page: tray 404 slides out of the oven empty, so you order and bake any other page fresh
about: A full not-found page for a Lahore bakery under a striped awning, with a moustached baker, a teal enamel oven and shelves of bread that are each a page of the site. The oven timer rings, the door drops and tray 404 comes out with nothing but crumbs. Order from the slip or pick a bread and the tray goes back in, the timer counts down and a fresh page comes out steaming with a Take it link.
how: The timer rings, the oven door drops and tray 404 slides out empty while the baker gasps
Type in What are you hungry for? and press Bake it, or pick a result with the arrow keys
Press any bread on the shelf to bake that page, or press Bake something else for a surprise
Watch the tray go in, the dial count down and the fresh bake slide out with steam and a ticket
Click the baker for a puff of flour and a line; his eyes follow your pointer
It plays a short demo by itself until you click or type
